results.description: spi must be a directory (src/spi/mod.rs) with real code — a flat src/spi.rs file or an empty/comment-only src/spi/mod.rs is invalid SEA structure
api/ root must not contain loose .rs files or mixed-layout directories — only mod.rs at root; no flat traits/types/error/ dirs when domain-grouped layout (api/<domain>/traits/) is active

violations.fix_hint: Move to the appropriate subdirectory: traits → api/traits/, types → api/types/, errors → api/error/

results.description: Source files must not suppress the dead_code lint via #[allow(dead_code)]
saf/ pub fn return types must be declared in api/types/ (when spi/ is absent)
saf/ methods must not be thin wrappers — a saf/ method whose entire body delegates to a free function or another method adds no value and signals incomplete consolidation
api/ files and types must not use the Default* prefix — Default* names signal a concrete implementation variant that belongs in core/, not in the contract layer
core/ (L2) struct names must not end with Impl — use the Default* prefix (or Local*, Remote*, InMemory*, Noop*, <Technology>*) to name concrete implementation variants
Cargo.toml must not declare [[test]] targets — integration tests in tests/ are auto-discovered
